snippet.title: Beastfolk Barber - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A snip here, a story there. Nowhere's more honest than the barber's chair.

You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

Wishlist Beastfolk Barber✂️ https://utm.to/967yzt

Beastfolk Barber is developed by Safe Flight Games, originally incubated by GameWorks, with development and publishing support from SIGONO.
